watches.name: Laco Pilot Watch ORIGINAL Memmingen Erbstück
watches.description: A triangle with two dots, eleven large numerals and the traces of a long life: the Memmingen Erbstück is a historically faithful, hand-aged pilot watch with a type A dial and hand-wound movement. It looks like a pilot watch from the 1940s that has found its way into the present. Behind this impression lies genuine handcraft. Laco works the case, dial, hands and strap individually until the patina, scratches and discoloration look natural. This makes every Memmingen Erbstück one of a kind. The construction follows the original as well: barrel shape, straight lugs, closed press-fit case back and a crown like that of the observation watch. Of the five historic manufacturers worldwide, Laco is the only one that still makes pilot watches in this construction today. The hand-wound movement is wound daily via the crown, and the aged brown riveted vintage leather strap completes the picture. watches.name: Laco Squad Watches Atacama Quarz UTC MB
watches.description: The Atacama Quarz UTC MB combines a second time zone, a Swiss quartz movement and a black DLC-coated stainless steel bracelet in a squad watch that is equally reliable in everyday life and on duty. You read the second time zone from the UTC hand with its skeletonized arrow tip on the orange 24-hour scale; the quick-set function makes adjusting it fast. The quartz movement keeps time to within a few seconds per month and runs without winding – an advantage when the watch has to be right immediately, even after days in the locker. The steel bracelet with folding clasp and safety catch sits securely and does not open accidentally; thanks to quick-release spring bars, it is easy to swap for a rubber strap. At 10.5 mm, the DLC-coated case is remarkably slim, conically shaped and fitted with flexible end pieces. The screw-down crown at 12 o'clock with orange control ring, the unidirectional countdown bezel and water resistance to 20 ATM make the watch ready for duty. The Atacama Quarz UTC MB thus extends Laco's range of functional watches with a rugged quartz squad watch on a metal bracelet. watches.name: Islander x Santurce Collection TORTUGA
watches.description: Islander x Santurce Collection TORTUGA Collaboration Watch #ISL-365 Introducing the Islander x Santurce TORTUGA , a collaboration with our friends at Islander. SOLD directly at Island Watch The first thing you'll notice is the dial. It has a deep, pebbled/sand texture and a blue gradient brightest at the center and fades to nearly black at the edges, like looking down into open deepwater. Bold Arabic numerals at the even hours and baton markers in between are all filled with vintage-toned lume (bright green glow in the dark), giving the watch a warm, aged look against the cool blue. Look closely and you'll see that the dial text is in Spanish: "Automatico" and "200M/656 Pies," a small nod to the watch's Puerto Rican roots. The hands are brushed silver: a sword-style hour hand and a bold arrow minute hand, both filled with the same vintage lume. The black seconds hand carries a lume pip, and its counterweight is a baby “tinglar” leather back sea turtle. Puerto Rico is known for highest concentration of nesting leatherback sea turtles in the United States.It's one of those details you may not notice at first, and once you do, you'll find yourself looking for it every time you check the time. The ISL-365 shares its proportions with our popular Northport. The stainless steel case is a very wearable 40.5mm in diameter, only 12.5mm thick, and 47mmfrom lug tip to lug tip. The new oversized screw-down crown is engraved with Santurce’s logo and with 200 meters of water resistance ensure it's up to the challenge of a watery environment. Inside is the Miyota 9039 movement, which beats at 28,800 beats per hour, so the seconds hand ticks 8 times per second for a smooth sweep. The movement can be hand-wound and hacks (the seconds hand stops when you set the time). Because the 9039 has no date, the dial stays clean and symmetrical.The coin-edge dive bezel holds a black sapphire insert with vintage-toned markings that match the dial. Sapphire resists scratching, and so does the sapphire crystal over the dial. Turn the watch over and you'll find a solid stainless steel caseback etched with a leatherback sea turtle on the seashore preparing to lay eggs beneath the sun, along with the Santurce Collection name. The Spanish continues on the back with "Acero Inoxidable" and "RAA: 200M." The ISL-365 comes on a 20mm black FKM rubber strap with a textured pattern. It's comfortable, durable, and ready for the water.
